units.source_text: 我同夫人交谈了几句，大竹七段的身影早已从庭院消失了。

en.t: After I had exchanged a few words with the lady, Otake 7-dan had already disappeared from the garden.

units.source_text: 接着他又麻利地换上带家徽的礼服，衣冠整齐地带着自己的妻子到名人和工作人员的房间去致意，也到我的房间来了。

en.t: Then he quickly changed into formal dress bearing his family crest, and, neatly attired, took his wife to pay his respects in the rooms of the Meijin and the staff, and came to my room as well.
